rows.kind: defaults override the caller and mutate
rows.summary: Fix withDefaults to not mutate input and let caller values override defaults by assigning to a fresh object (defaults first).
Fix memoization to key on all arguments instead of only the first, preventing stale cached answers for different second args.
Make loadAll await all fetchOne calls with Promise.all so it resolves to the list of results instead of a list of promises.
Require a dot (and chars around it) in the domain part of the email regex, so 'a@b' fails while 'a@b.co' and multi-part domains still pass.
Rename fetchUser to getUser: definition and export in users.js, import and call in greeting.js.
Fix get() to refresh the entry's position (delete+set) so a just-read item is considered recently used and not evicted on next insert.
Fix formatDuration to correctly compute minutes and seconds using modulo, so 3725s becomes '1h 2m 5s' instead of '1h 62m 3725s'.
Update parseAge to validate input and throw RangeError for invalid ages (non-integer, negative, or >150) while returning valid numbers.
Fix subtotal to multiply price by qty so cart totals correctly count quantities instead of charging duplicate items only once.
Make removeAt return a new array without mutating the input by using slice+concat instead of splice.
Fix off-by-one error in pagination: page 1 should start at index 0, not size. Pages numbered from 1.

rows.kind: sort: direction, tie-break and no mutation
rows.summary: Fix rank to return a copy sorted by descending score then ascending name, without mutating input.

rows.kind: defaults override the caller and mutate
rows.summary: Fix withDefaults to copy from defaults then override with caller values (so caller wins) and return a fresh object (no mutation).
Use all arguments (via JSON.stringify) as the cache key instead of only the first one, so different second args produce different results and no stale answers.
Make loadAll await all fetchOne calls with Promise.all so it resolves to the list of results instead of a list of promises.
Update isEmail regex to require at least one dot in the part after @ (so 'a@b' is invalid) while still matching the valid examples that have dots in the domain.
Rename fetchUser to getUser in definition, export, require, and call under apps/web/src.
Fix LRU get to refresh the entry (delete+re-set) so a just-read entry is treated as recently used and not evicted on next set when full.
Fix formatDuration to compute remaining minutes and seconds correctly using modulo, so 3725s becomes '1h 2m 5s' instead of '1h 62m 3725s'.
Update parseAge to throw RangeError containing 'invalid age' for NaN, negative, or >150; return number otherwise.
Fix cart total to multiply price by qty (default 1) instead of summing price once per line item.
Fix removeAt to return a new array without mutating the input by using slice instead of splice.
